Hindu activists detained attempting to surround actor Prakash Raj

Hindu activists were detained in Dharwad, Karnataka, for attempting to surround actor Prakash Raj. The activists reportedly intended to protest against Raj. Police intervened and detained the activists to prevent the confrontation.
